headline: Estonia Considers Suspending Railway Traffic with Russia Amid Security Tensions
summary: Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal stated that Tallinn could suspend railway traffic with Russia as a further response to sabotage attacks targeting its defense industry.
why: Border and transport restrictions between Baltic states and Russia impact regional logistics and cross-border commercial freight operations.

impacts.name: Estonia
impacts.why: The national government is evaluating a suspension of transport links.
